worldcombat.skill.tailwhip.summary: Aim toward where you want to withdraw, then whip your tail from one side to the other and back again, dazing and lowering the Defense of every foe that can see it in a 120-degree band behind you. You must turn a foe behind you first; enemies charging from the front are not swept. The tail must be seen, so cover blocks it.
worldcombat.skill.tailwhip.use.0: Turn and break the guard of a chaser behind you
worldcombat.skill.tailwhip.use.1: Hold off the threat behind while you withdraw
worldcombat.skill.tailwhip.use.2: Open a gap behind you for an ally's physical attacks
worldcombat.skill.tailwhip.description.0: Foes swept by the tail temporarily lose %1$s Defense stage(s) and are marked guardbroken for %2$s: the Defense drop is tied to that mark, so it is restored when the daze ends or the mark is cured or cleared. A target carrying the mark still loses one more Defense stage to moves that rip open an old gap. The sweep deals no damage, and one foe is only dropped once across both swings.
worldcombat.skill.tailwhip.description.1: Tail radius %1$s, catching every visible, in-sight non-friendly in the 120-degree band behind you; cover blocks it.
worldcombat.skill.tailwhip.description.2: Windup %1$s with a %2$s cooldown. Aim toward your escape (the code does not turn you): the committed direction sets your facing and the tail sweeps behind it. The tip crosses side-to-side and returns 6 ticks later, the second pass covering wherever you then stand.
worldcombat.skill.tailwhip.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.tailwhip.preference.ai: The companion only steps in to whip while a threat is within this many blocks; smaller keeps it at point-blank, larger approaches on its own.
The companion only whips when at least this many visible, not-yet-broken non-friendly bodies are inside the tail radius, so the windup is not wasted; 1 means whip whenever it sees one.
When on, the companion may leave its post to whip its tail under a Hold order.
